name: BulbaCraft Funny Nurse Stickers (100 Pieces)
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Stickers Gift Pack 100 Pieces
metaDescription: A pack of 100 funny nurse stickers for laptops, cups, and planners. A budget friendly gift that brings some laughs to nurses, students, and the whole unit.
summary: A big pack of funny nurse stickers that gives the recipient plenty to keep and plenty to share, a fun pick for nurses with a sense of humor.
bestFor: Secret Santa at the nurses station
whyItWorks: Humor is how a lot of nurses get through hard days. A pack of funny nurse stickers captures the jokes they already tell each other in the break room, from coffee dependence to the realities of night shift. Seeing those jokes on a water bottle or laptop is a small reminder that someone gets what their job is like.

With 100 stickers, the pack goes a long way. One nurse could cover a laptop, a planner, and a work cup and still have plenty left to hand out. That makes it handy for a Secret Santa exchange, for filling Nurses Week goodie bags, or for a nursing student who wants to decorate study gear and share some with classmates. Stickers are also low risk as a gift. If you are not sure of someone's taste, a mixed pack of jokes offers enough variety that they will find favorites. Pair it with a blank tumbler or a notebook so they have something to decorate right away.
goodToKnow: Look through the listing images to make sure the humor suits the recipient and their workplace.
Check the listing for whether the stickers are waterproof if they will go on cups or bottles.
A pack this size splits easily into several smaller gifts for coworkers.

faq.q: Are these stickers appropriate for work?
faq.a: Most nurse sticker packs keep the humor light, but scan the listing images if the recipient works somewhere conservative.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, students love decorating laptops and planners, and the large count means they can share with their study group.
